producer.note: data-free MSE quantization from tencent/Hy4-flash@d88c9dfd96ba; schema follows ModelOpt

quantization_config.comment: Weight-only checkpoint, no activation or KV-cache quantization. Routed experts are stacked per layer ([512, out, in] codes, weight_scale [512, out, in/16], weight_scale_2 [512]). FP8_PB_WO block scales are stored as weight_scale_inv [ceil(out/128), ceil(in/128)] F32 (the tencent/Hy4-flash-FP8 naming), multiply to dequantize; ModelOpt's own export names this tensor weight_scale. The four engram n-gram tables (model.layers.1.engram_layer.multi_head_embedding.embedding, model.layers.11.engram_layer.multi_head_embedding.embedding, model.layers.21.engram_layer.multi_head_embedding.embedding, model.layers.31.engram_layer.multi_head_embedding.embedding) are FP8 E4M3 with one F32 scale per row (weight, weight_scale [rows]); no ModelOpt quant_algo describes per-row FP8 embeddings, so they are listed in neither quantized_layers nor exclude_modules. See LAYOUT.md and quant_config.json.
